name: artifact_export
description: Ask to bring one file the runtime reported (from artifact_list) out to this computer. The user is asked to approve it on the Host; then the Host receives the file, checks its format and scans it, and only a file that passes is saved to the results folder. This returns at once with the accepted state; follow progress with artifact_list until the status is EXPORTED (export_path is then set) or BLOCKED (result says why). Calling it again for the same artifact_id returns its current state without starting a second transfer. Only plain UTF-8 .txt files are exported for now.

reason.description: Why the user needs this file; shown to the user in the approval prompt (marked as written by you) and kept in the audit log.
